args.stdin: WITH base AS (SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE LOWER(TRIM(brand)) LIKE '%heco%' AND (LOWER(series) LIKE '%gtu-ypj%' OR LOWER(model) LIKE '%gtu-ypj%' OR LOWER(product_name) LIKE '%gtu-ypj%' OR LOWER(series) LIKE '%topfix%' OR LOWER(product_name) LIKE '%topfix%') ORDER BY product_sku LIMIT 1), props AS (SELECT product_sku, MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(property_key) LIKE '%screw%type%' AND LOWER(property_value_text) LIKE '%wood%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_screw_type, MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(property_key) LIKE '%diameter%' AND (property_value_number = 6 OR LOWER(TRIM(property_value_text)) IN ('6 mm','6mm','6')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_diameter, MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(property_key) LIKE '%length%' AND (property_value_number = 120 OR LOWER(TRIM(property_value_text)) IN ('120 mm','120mm','120')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_length FROM product_variant_properties GROUP BY product_sku) SELECT b.product_sku, b.record_path, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.has_screw_type,0)=1 AND COALESCE(p.has_diameter,0)=1 AND COALESCE(p.has_length,0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS extra_holds FROM base b LEFT JOIN props p ON p.product_sku = b.product_sku;
